title: Corpus integrity
description: The integrity blob of CorpusProcess.wit, written from the server's own account of the run: what the results rest on and everything that did not go the plain way. pairs: the share of shards (CorpusOptions.SamplingRate) that came back twice in the first round, their two results compared on everything an honest node cannot vary (verdict, content hash, the hash of the signatures, document counts, drop and language histograms, the PDF counts). disputes: the shards whose copies disagreed, what up to three machines returned for each, and whether the most of them, two at least and without a tie, returned the same. no_result: the shards no machine returned an acceptable result for. rejected: the values dropped on arrival, by reason. A shard in none of these was run once and its result is one machine's word (single_execution). The platform keeps the copies of a shard on different machines and the document does not say which; it cannot see a machine that holds two shards and answers one of them twice (where that makes more answers than were sent out, the shard is held back). Version 5: version 4 let a result opt out of the comparison by the version it claimed, and chose the execution that stood for a shard by its own content hash.

controller.description: The server's controller version: the only one a result of this run carries.

single_execution.description: Shards whose accepted result is one machine's word: nothing compared it.

sampled.description: Shards that came back more than once in the first round (pairs).

compared.description: Pairs whose two sides are results with a verdict on the shard.

version_skew.description: Always 0; kept for readers of version 4. A result that claims another controller version is dropped and counted in rejected (reason version).

incomplete.description: Pairs with a side that is no result: a node fault or a dropped value (not compared; a mismatch is two results that disagree).

mismatches.description: Compared pairs that disagree; each is a dispute.

mismatch_rate.description: mismatches / compared; 0 when nothing was compared.

signatures_compared.description: Compared pairs whose sides made signatures, compared by their hashes (0 when the pipeline does not sign).

signature_mismatches.description: Compared pairs whose signatures differ (each also counted in mismatches, with signatures among its differences).

rejected_results.description: Values dropped on arrival over every round; rejected has them by reason.

node_faults.description: Results returned as a fault of the node, over every round.

repairs.description: Shards sent out once more: the first round left them without a result.

repaired.description: Of those, the ones the second try gave a result.

no_result.description: Shards that ended without a result (NoResult in the report).

disputes.description: Shards whose copies disagreed, or that came back more often than they were sent out.

disputes_resolved.description: Of those, the ones settled by the most machines, two at least, without a tie.

disputed.description: Of those, the ones that stayed open (Disputed in the report): out of the counts and the products.

rejected.description: The dropped values by reason: not_a_result (no result at all), unknown_ticket (under no ticket of this job and round: another job's, another round's, a shard the node was not given), malformed (not shaped as an honest node shapes a result), foreign_task (the ticket is one shard's, the index or URL another's), version (another controller version than the server's), inconsistent (at odds with its task: output mode, MinHash parameters, blobs, byte cap, languages).

pairs.description: One record per shard that came back more than once in the first round, ordered by index: its first two results in the order the platform handed them over.

results.description: Present when more than two came back: more answers than the round sent out (one machine answered twice); the shard goes to the dispute round.

incomplete.description: Present and true when a side is no result (a node fault, a dropped value).

signatures.description: Present when compared: the sides made the same signatures, different ones, or none (the pipeline does not sign: nothing to compare).

differs.description: Present on a mismatch: the fields that differ.

dispute.description: Present and true when the shard went to the dispute round.

disputes.description: One record per shard whose copies disagreed, ordered by index.

outcome.description: resolved: one result was returned by the most machines, two at least, without a tie, and it is the shard's. disputed: no such result (fewer than two machines agreed, a tie, more answers than machines, or the dispute round did not run); the shard is Disputed in the report.

executions.description: The machines that returned the accepted result; 0 when disputed.

results.description: What came back in the dispute round, in the order the platform handed it over.

accepted.description: Present when resolved: the accepted result.

no_result.description: One record per shard that ended without a result, ordered by index.

reason.description: node_fault: every machine that held the shard returned it as a fault of its own. rejected: everything returned for it was dropped. missing: nothing came back under its tickets.

faults.description: The fault codes the nodes gave for the shard, each once.

fault.description: A node's fault, a fixed code: disk (a local file could not be written or read), disk_space (no room for the shard), network (the origin did not answer this node after every retry), language_model (the model did not arrive or does not match its pin), pdf_sandbox (the PDF sandbox failed to run a document), pdf_backstop (a PDF ran into the wall-clock backstop with fuel left), upload (a product could not be uploaded), memory (out of memory), internal (anything else inside the node).

kind.description: execution: a result with a verdict on the shard. fault: the node returned the shard unanswered. rejected: the value was dropped.

code.description: Present for a fault (its code) and for a rejected value (the reason).

controller.description: The controller version of an execution; empty otherwise.

verdict.description: The verdict of an execution; empty otherwise.

signatures_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the signatures blob as the side made it, kept or not; empty when it made none.
